content.text: Working tree clean, HEAD unchanged; my research is current. Give compact repeat.

Yes — research is complete and the tree is unchanged (HEAD b48a2cf, clean). Compact findings:

**Relevant files**
- `CMakePresets.json`: version 3, cmakeMinimumRequired 3.22; 12 public configure presets (`msvc-win64-release`, `clang-macos-release`, `gcc-linux-release`, + debug/ninja variants), mirrored in `buildPresets`/`testPresets`; binaries go to `${sourceDir}/build/debug|release`.
- `.github/workflows/workflow.yml`: CI does **not** call any script. It runs `git submodule update --init --recursive`, then `cmake --preset`, `cmake --build --preset "<name>" -j`, `ctest --preset <name> --output-on-failure`. Presets: Linux `gcc-linux-release`, Windows `msvc-win64-ninja-release` (with msvc-dev-cmd), macOS `clang-macos-ninja-release`. Zero `git lfs` in CI.
- `tests/CMakeLists.txt`: `tiffImageTest`/`tiffExporterTest` (doctest), `BUILD_MAKE_REFERENCE_IMG=OFF` default (FetchContent libtiff v4.7.1rc1 only when ON). `CMakeLists.txt`: `enable_testing()` + `add_subdirectory(tests|apps|examples)`; no submodule/LFS logic in CMake since commit 3321333. `.gitmodules`: `tests/libtiff-pics` → gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff-pics.git. **No AGENTS.md anywhere.** Only scripts in repo: the 5 root files; only `build.sh`, `install.sh`, `run_test.sh` source `shared_cmake_preset.sh` (grep-confirmed).

**Current contents (unchanged)**
- `shared_cmake_preset.sh` (sourced): `PRESET_NAME=$1` (L6), `HOST_OS=$OS$OSTYPE` (L7 — `$OS` unset on Linux/macOS; verified `set -u` aborts), `` INSTALL_DIR=`pwd`/install `` (L10, backticks, unquoted), `if [[ $1 == "" ]]` (L23), `exit 1` (L40, kills sourcing shell). Auto-picks `msvc-win64-release` / `clang-macos-release` / `gcc-linux-release`.
- `build.sh`: L4 `source "$(dirname "$0")/shared_cmake_preset.sh" "$1"`; L6–11 submodule/LFS block (to delete); L15 `-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}` **unquoted**.
- `install.sh`: L14 `source ... "$PRESET_ARG"`; L17 `cmake --build --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" --target install`; L30/L40 use cwd-relative `install/...` paths and write tarballs to cwd; no strict mode today.
- `run_test.sh`: L4 unguarded `"$1"`; L8 `ctest --preset "${PRESET_NAME}" --output-on-failure --rerun-failed` (note: `--rerun-failed` with no prior run = 0 tests, exit 0).
- `build.bat`: `[%1] == []` test, unquoted `%PRESET_NAME%` throughout, `%PRESET_NAME%&&cmake` (missing space), no LFS steps (none to remove), no prefix handling.

**cd placement verdict**
`cd` belongs **only in the entry-point scripts** (`build.sh`, `install.sh`, `run_test.sh`, via `cd /d "%~dp0"` in `build.bat`). **Never in `shared_cmake_preset.sh`** — it's sourced, so a `cd` leaks into the sourcing process; the helper must stay side-effect-free. Helper needs: `set -euo pipefail`, `${1:-}`, and — required for `set -u` — `HOST_OS=${OS:-}${OSTYPE:-}`; `INSTALL_DIR="$(pwd)/install"` reads cwd **after** the entry script's `cd`, pinning install to repo root. Caveat: entry scripts use `source "$(dirname "$0")/..."` with a cwd-relative path, so after `cd` the source path breaks for invocations like `bash subdir/build.sh`; use `SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"` and `source "$SCRIPT_DIR/shared_cmake_preset.sh" "${1:-}"`. Same unguarded `"$1"` must become `"${1:-}"` in `build.sh`/`run_test.sh` since `set -u` would abort before the helper runs. Also flag `install.sh`'s cwd-relative `install/` paths (tarball/zip land in repo root after cd — behavior change, likely intended) and the sourced `exit 1` (consider `return 1`).

**Validation commands (verbatim from README/CI)**
- Fixtures: `git clone --recursive https://github.com/danielm5/tiffcraft.git`; `git submodule update --init --recursive`; `git -C tests/libtiff-pics lfs pull` (CI runs only the submodule line).
- Build: `./build.sh` / `./build.sh gcc-linux-release` / `cmake --preset gcc-linux-release` + `cmake --build --preset gcc-linux-release -j`.
- Test: `ctest --preset gcc-linux-release --output-on-failure` / `./run_test.sh`.
- CI per-OS presets as above; **CI impact: none** (scripts not exercised).
- Post-#24 checks: `cd /elsewhere && /path/to/build.sh gcc-linux-release` must work; `bash -n` all scripts; confirm no `git submodule`/`git lfs` in build.sh; quote check `-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="…with spaces…"`.

**Docs impact classification: docs edits required.** Stale quotes: `README.md:38` — "`./build.sh` runs the submodule and LFS steps for you; otherwise pull the" (manual-fetch paragraphs then become the only path); `CHANGELOG.md:20–22` — "- build.sh fetches the tests/libtiff-pics submodule and its Git LFS objects before configuring, so a fresh clone with git-lfs installed builds and tests cleanly." (now false; move to Changed/Removed). Still accurate: `README.md:22` (prerequisites), `README.md:45–46` (auto-preset), `README.md:67–68` ("without git-lfs … tests will fail with \"Invalid byte order in TIFF header\"" — becomes more prominent). No changes needed to CI, presets, CMake files, tests, or scripts' doc invocations. Also note `build.sh:10`'s "fixture sanity-check instructions" message was already stale (check dropped in 3321333) and is deleted by #24 anyway.
